title: Todd and the Bud with Its Coat On
synopsis: Todd compares his old first-sprout drawing with the tall sunflower buds; on a later visit he sees the first narrow line of yellow.
continuity_state: Before: One of the tall sunflower stems has a closed green bud; the second is shorter with a smaller bud. Todd has his old sprout-and-boot drawing at home. After: Across two visits with Aunt Pat, Todd compares the old drawing with present buds and makes a second drawing on the back of the same sheet. Several days later the larger bud shows a thin pale-yellow edge within its folds; it is not yet open. Todd takes his drawings home to Reed Meadow. No garden plant is handled or forced open.

related_resources.reason: NYBG describes sunflower floral development as distinct from early vegetative growth; a closed bud is not a failed flower.
